seoDescription: Search 2,900+ SmartRecruiters companies at once: titles, places, remote and hybrid work, job types, pay and exact posting times. Newest first, no login.
defaultRunOptions$comment: TODO_DEPLOYED: measure the empty form {"maxJobs":100} and the example input at 512, 1024 and 2048 MB on the deployed build (seconds, usageTotalUsd, peak memory), then set the default here, in tasks.json options and in this note. 2 GB until then: a search is about 3,100 API calls (3,062 for the empty form and 3,097 for the example input in local runs on 2026-11-02, 29 to 31 s on a laptop at 64 at once), and Cornerstone's CPU-bound pass of 2,220 calls took 283 s at 512 MB, 143 s at 1 GB and 69 s at 2 GB for the same compute cost (2026-10-30). Apify's daily test runs the empty form and must finish in 300 s.

pricing.$comment: 2026-11-02. Rule: rules/SEO.md section 16 and the batch brief section 8; users and FREE-tier prices from GET /v2/acts/<user>~<name> the same day. Main competitor by 30-day users for a SmartRecruiters job: fantastic-jobs/career-site-job-listing-api, 1,632 u30, $0.012 a row plus $0.01 a run, a stored database of 58 ATS where smartrecruiters is one filter. It is absent from the Store's 82 results for 'smartrecruiters', and its own feed sells the same rows at $0.0025 plus $0.10 a run, so it is not the anchor. The anchor for the same job, a SmartRecruiters row with its description from one keyword across every company: jobo.world at $0.004 (ats-jobs-api 134 u30; smartrecruiters-jobs-scraper-api 5 u30, #1 to #3 for 'smartrecruiters', 'smartrecruiters scraper' and 'smartrecruiters jobs api'), beside memo23/career-site-ats-jobs-api $0.004 plus $0.03 (81 u30) and hirebase $0.005 plus $0.001 (138 u30). job-details $0.0035 is 12.5% under $0.004; job $0.0025 is a list row with no description and no pay, as deel-jobs-search prices it. Cheaper for companies you already know: bovi $0.0015 (100 u30), memo23/smartrecruiters-scraper $0.0009 plus $0.025 (3 u30). No start fee: a 100-row run's compute is estimated at $0.005 to $0.012 at 2 GB (about 3,100 calls; TODO_DEPLOYED), 2.5 to 6% of the $0.20 such a run earns after Apify's 20%, under SEO.md 16.4's tenth; the loss case is a filter that matches nothing, which reads every page (7,221 calls locally) for an estimated $0.025 and earns nothing. apify-actor-start is charged before the input is read, so it would also charge runs that end with nothing, and a start event charged after the first read needs the shared engine. If the publish phase measures a 100-row run above $0.02, add a start fee before the first publish: defining it then is free, later it costs 14 days' notice. Start high while private: a cut is free, a raise costs a month. Gentle ladder per the owner's decision of 2026-10-29.

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, location, work type, job type, department, posting date, job and apply links. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description as text and HTML, pay with its currency and period, reference number, city, region, country and country code.
